name: Acta de comité municipal
description: Acta formal en español con orden del día, argumentos, mociones, votaciones, decisiones, acciones y pruebas.

sections.title: Puntos del orden del día
sections.objective: List the agenda items in meeting order, preserving any explicit item number and the supported disposition of each item.

output_fields.label: Número
output_fields.description: Número de orden indicado en la reunión.

sections.title: Argumentos de los participantes
sections.objective: Summarize material arguments and attribute each one to the correct participant without judging motives or persuasiveness.

output_fields.label: Punto del orden del día
output_fields.description: Punto al que se refiere el argumento.

sections.title: Mociones
sections.objective: Extract formal motions and their proposer, wording, amendments, and disposition only when supported by the transcript.

output_fields.label: Punto
output_fields.description: Punto del orden del día relacionado.

sections.title: Acuerdos y decisiones
sections.objective: List adopted committee decisions separately from proposals and ambiguous discussion.

output_fields.label: Punto
output_fields.description: Punto del orden del día relacionado.

sections.title: Resultados de las votaciones
sections.objective: Record voting outcomes exactly as announced, including abstentions and absent members only when stated; never infer missing counts.

output_fields.label: A favor
output_fields.description: Número anunciado de votos a favor.

output_fields.label: En contra
output_fields.description: Número anunciado de votos en contra.

sections.title: Tareas acordadas
sections.objective: List confirmed action items with responsible people and deadlines only when explicitly assigned.

sections.title: Plazos
sections.objective: Extract formal deadlines, future committee dates, and timing windows without inventing calendar values.

sections.title: Preguntas pendientes
sections.objective: List substantive questions that remained unanswered or were explicitly deferred.

output_fields.label: Punto
output_fields.description: Punto del orden del día relacionado.
